jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Training Specialist**

Our firm represents a broad array of clients in class and mass actions, individual arbitrations, and multidistrict litigation matters at the trial and appellate levels in federal and state courts. Serving hundreds of thousands of clients in litigation and arbitration, we have prosecuted high\-profile mass tort, antitrust, privacy, product liability, employment, and consumer\-rights cases. Our firm also acts as plaintiffs' counsel in high\-stakes public\-enforcement actions. Our mission is to achieve exceptional results for our clients, drive innovation in the practice of law, and pursue unparalleled excellence in everything we do.


**Purpose:** The Training Specialist is responsible for designing and conducting onboarding and training programs that will boost employees' workplace performance in alliance with Keller Postman's core values. This individual will work closely with the Training \& QA Manager and, under their guidance, assess training needs, design, and deliver curriculum and learning materials for all phases of training from onboarding to continuing professional development.



This is a **full\-time, in\-person** position based in our **Lake Mary, Florida**, office. Compensation for the position includes an annual base salary of $72,000 to $82,000, commensurate with experience, plus the role is eligible for a year\-end discretionary bonus and benefits.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Partner with leaders and subject matter experts to identify performance gaps, define learning goals, and determine when training is the right solution.
* Design training from initial needs assessment through development, delivery, and evaluation. Write measurable learning objectives and align content, practice activities, and assessments with those objectives.
* Develop instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced learning materials, including facilitator guides, presentations, e\-learning modules, job aids, simulations, and knowledge checks.
* Apply adult learning principles by building on employees' experience, using realistic workplace scenarios, allowing time for practice, and providing useful feedback.
* Facilitate interactive sessions for audiences with different roles, experience levels, and learning needs.
* Use learning technology confidently, including learning management systems, e\-learning authoring tools, virtual classroom platforms, and multimedia tools. Publish and maintain content, track completions, and use available learning data to identify improvements.
* Help employees and facilitators use learning tools and troubleshoot routine access or delivery issues.
* Evaluate training through feedback, assessments, and relevant performance measures\-update materials when findings or business processes change.
* Manage training schedules, records, and multiple projects while keeping materials accurate and current.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of corporate learning experience
* Experience designing and facilitating workplace training in both live and digital formats.
* Knowledge of and demonstrable ability to apply instructional design methods, adult learning principles, and ways to assess whether learning has transferred to the job.
* Experience using a learning management system and e\-learning authoring tools, with the ability to learn new platforms quickly.
* Strong presentation, writing, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to simplify complex information and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts and leaders.
* Comfort facilitating in\-person and virtual sessions and resolving common learning technology issues.
* Microsoft Office proficiency.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Associates or Bachelor's degree
* Professional Training \& Development Learning Certifications (such as Association for Talent Development Certified Professional in Talent Development or Associate Professional in Talent Development; Training Industry Certified Professional in Training Management; International Society for Performance Improvement Certified Performance Technologist; Management and Strategy Institute Corporate Trainer Certified; and Six Sigma Global Institute Corporate Trainer Certification)


**Interview Process**


* Candidates who make it to the final round of interviews will be expected to create and facilitate a short presentation with a training aid.


Keller Postman is an Equal Opportunity Employer. For California Applicants, please find our CCPA information here.

jobs.title: Asset & Wealth Management, Talent Development, Wealth Solutions and Private Bank Training, Onboarding, and Development - Vice President - New York
jobs.description:
YOUR IMPACT


The Wealth Solutions and Private Bank Training, Onboarding and Development Vice President will lead the design, delivery, and continuous enhancement of onboarding, training, and development across the Wealth Solutions and Private Bank platform, including Private Bank, Private Family Office, Goldman Sachs Family Office, Goldman Sachs Trust Company, Wealth Strategy, Capital Markets, Managed Strategies, Equity Structuring, Alternative Capital Markets and related specialist businesses. This role will build a consistent, business\-specific learning experience that accelerates new hire integration, deepens product and platform fluency, strengthens technical capabilities, and helps professionals understand how each business contributes to the broader Wealth Management client and advisor experience.


The individual will partner closely with Wealth Solutions, Private Bank and Talent Strategy leadership to evaluate current training resources, identify gaps against business priorities, and re\-underwrite the onboarding curriculum for campus, lateral and role\-based entry points. The role requires a commercially minded learning leader who can translate complex, fast\-evolving businesses, tools and workflows into practical training pathways, while using peer analysis and market benchmarking to ensure the Wealth Solutions and Private Bank learning model remains differentiated, scalable and execution\-oriented.


**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**


* Lead the end\-to\-end onboarding experience for Wealth Solutions and Private Bank professionals, ensuring consistency where appropriate and tailored depth where business models, client segments, regulatory considerations or product complexity differ.
* Design and deliver training programs that build technical expertise, product knowledge, advisor enablement, client engagement skills and fluency across core Wealth Solutions and Private Bank businesses, tools and workflows.
* Review and inventory current training content, resource hubs, playbooks, vendor materials, AI prompts, knowledge libraries and adoption resources to determine what should be preserved, refreshed, retired or scaled.
* Re\-underwrite the onboarding curriculum across campus, lateral and internal mobility populations, incorporating self\-study, live training, business\-led sessions, office hours and applied case studies.
* Develop role\-based learning journeys that support consistency, career growth and progression across analysts, associates, vice presidents, executive directors and managing directors, with clear expectations by business, level and point of entry.
* Partner with senior business leaders, product owners, COOs, regional leads, managers and advisors to identify capability gaps, development priorities and emerging learning needs tied to business growth, risk management and adoption of new tools.
* Create and maintain practical learning resources, onboarding guides, toolkits, quick\-reference materials and knowledge assets that improve employee effectiveness and reduce dependency on informal knowledge transfer.
* Facilitate virtual and in\-person training programs, workshops, and development sessions.
* Manage a structured continuing education framework that promotes ongoing learning and growth.
* Leverage technology, AI\-enabled tools, adoption dashboards and digital learning platforms to improve training effectiveness, tracking, scale self\-service support and reinforce consistent use of priority Wealth Solutions and Private Bank tooling.
* Measure program effectiveness through feedback and development metrics, using insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Conduct peer analysis and internal/external benchmarking to compare onboarding, technical training, and specialist development models across the Firm, relevant financial services, private bank, wealth management and family office peers.
* Partner with the broader Talent Strategy team and business leadership on talent development, career progression, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Foster knowledge sharing, best\-practice exchange and peer learning across Wealth Solutions and Private Bank teams, with intentional forums that connect specialist expertise to advisor and client outcomes.
* Maintain centralized learning content and resource libraries, including Knowledge Bank\-style hubs, playbooks, curricula and user guides, to keep materials current, searchable, accessible and tied to active business priorities.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**


* 5\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Strategy, Human Capital Management, or a related field
* Knowledge of Wealth Management, Private Banking, Wealth Solutions, Capital Markets, investment products, fiduciary services, family office services, wealth planning or the broader financial services industry
* Experience designing and delivering scalable learning programs, curricula, and talent development initiatives
* Strong facilitation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to translate business priorities, product complexity, platform adoption needs and risk considerations into role\-based learning journeys, development frameworks and practical training solutions
* Familiarity with learning technologies, enterprise knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled tools, adoption dashboards and digital training channels
* Experience conducting peer analysis, benchmarking, capability assessments or program reviews to inform curriculum design and operating model decisions
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and stakeholder groups
* Data\-driven, execution\-oriented approach with a focus on measuring impact, continuous improvement, and business outcomes

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Keeper is hiring an analytical Senior Implementation Operations Specialist to join our B2B Support team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.



Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and help improve the systems, processes, and resources that support successful customer implementations.


**About Keeper**



Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.


**About the Role**



As a Senior Implementation Operations Specialist, you will independently identify operational challenges, analyze data, manage improvement projects, and develop scalable solutions for the Implementation organization. You will work closely with Implementation leadership and cross\-functional partners to translate complex business needs into clear processes, documentation, training, and measurable improvements. Additionally, the Senior Implementation Operations Specialist will drive initiatives that improve the efficiency, scalability, and maturity of our Implementation organization. This role combines business analysis, project management, process improvement, data validation, stakeholder communication, and training.


**Responsibilities**


* Analyze and validate data from Salesforce, Tableau, and other sources to identify trends, anomalies, root causes, and operational insights
* Build reports and analyses that support Implementation leadership's decision\-making and provide clear, actionable recommendations
* Identify and manage operational improvement opportunities and strategic initiatives from initial problem identification through delivery
* Gather requirements, develop solutions, manage risks and dependencies, resolve blockers, and measure project outcomes
* Maintain project documentation, status updates, and visibility through Jira and other project management tools
* Develop a strong understanding of Keeper's product suite and Implementation processes to identify meaningful opportunities for improvement
* Evaluate and improve existing processes while developing scalable solutions involving tools, automation, reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Partner with internal stakeholders to define requirements, coordinate solutions, and validate that delivered solutions meet operational needs
* Create clear documentation, process guidance, and supporting resources that promote consistent execution
* Design and deliver training for new processes, tools, and operational changes, including follow\-up to support adoption
* Communicate clearly and professionally with team members, cross\-functional partners, and leadership
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, and opportunities, using sound judgment to determine when escalation is appropriate
* Participate in special projects and continuously evaluate opportunities to improve operational efficiency and results


**Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in a business\-related field or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of progressive experience in operations, implementation, project management, business analysis, or a related role
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to build, analyze, and validate reports
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements and actionable solutions
* Experience managing projects from problem identification through delivery
* Strong organizational skills, execution, and follow\-through across multiple concurrent initiatives
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience facilitating cross\-functional discussions, driving alignment, and managing risks or escalations
* Experience creating process documentation, training materials, and operational resources
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Tableau or similar business intelligence tools
* Strong computer skills; Google Workspace or Microsoft Office experience strongly preferred
* Strong proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Ability to work effectively autonomously and as part of a team


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting SaaS implementations, customer onboarding, or professional services
* Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, technology, or enterprise software
* Experience with process improvement, automation, or operational efficiency initiatives
* Experience working with Jira or other project management tools
* Familiarity with change management and process adoption


**Benefits**


* Medical, Dental \& Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)
* Employer Paid Life Insurance \& Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
* Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
* 401k (Roth/Traditional)
* A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
* Above market annual bonuses


Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E\-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.



Classification: Exempt

  

**Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice**



This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).



1\. **Data We Collect**



Information You provide:


* Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
* Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
* Application responses and uploaded documents


Information We generate:


* Interview notes, assessments, communications
* Scheduling information


Information From Others:


* Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
* References (with your consent, before final offer)
* Public professional profiles
* Background verification (post offer)


Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information


* We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements


2\. **How We Use Your Data**


* Assess your application and suitability
* Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
* Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
* Comply with employment law obligations


3\. **Legal Basis**


* Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
* Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
* Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required


4\. **Who We Share Information With**



Internal:


* HR, hiring managers, interviewers\*, IT support for system administration


* Note \- diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.



Third Parties:



Service providers who assist with:


* Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
* Background verification vendors (post offer)
* Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
* Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data


Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.



5\. **International Transfers**



Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.


6\. **Security**



We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.



7\. **Retention**



We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.


Exceptions:


* You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
* You're hired (transfers to employee records)


8\. **Your Rights**



You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:


* Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
* Object to or restrict processing
* Withdraw consent (where applicable)
* Request data portability
* Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority


If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.



When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.



9\. **Automated Decisions**



Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.



10\. **Contact** \- Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

jobs.title: Implementation Lead (CONTRACT) REMOTE
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.


Broadridge is seeking a tenacious \& proactive **Implementations Manager** to join our growing North America team that works closely with clients to implement our strategic SaaS Corporate Actions \& Tax Reporting applications and its associated platform components in the Americas. Do you have a strong Asset Servicing and Tax background and a proven record of collaborating effectively with clients \& multiple teams to deliver outstanding results? Are you able to drive clients to onboard swiftly and efficiently? We'd love to hear from you!

 **Job Responsibilities**:

* **User Testing Management \& Reporting** – defining the testing strategy to support the project’s requirements and working with clients to accurately plan, track, report and expedite all phases of testing, challenging clients on change vs defect and ensuring development activity is focused on the essential issues for the priority milestones. Working with client to have clean and accurate data on test execution progress and issue tirage \& delivery.
* **Training** – plan and manage both internal and client training which includes the preparation of material, plans for delivery, and hands\-on product demonstrations \& training.
* **Change Control** – raising CRs and completing the required analysis in a timely manner to enable good governance of project change.
* **Risk Identification and Management** – identifying project risks, issues and dependencies and providing appropriate mitigation and timely escalation.
* **Data Integration / Configuration Definition** – working with our clients to define upstream and downstream data integration mapping, and any associated configuration to support the client’s business.
* **Migration/Conversion** – definition of the conversion strategy and the runbook to execute it. Managing mock conversions and final go\-live, ensuring any issues from the mocks are reported and tracked to completion in good time for subsequent mock runs. Includes reporting, internally and externally for all mock and go\=live activities to ensure good governance.
* **Planning \& Execution** \- participating in all phases of the planning, governance \& delivery of the implementation activities, including supporting clients during mock conversions \& go\-live weekends.
* **Implementation Governance** – providing the first level of control that the implementation’s plan activities are resourced and executed appropriately. Also includes internal \& external reporting, issue escalation \& management and representing BR on Project Steering Committee meetings and Working Groups.
* **Production Compare Management \& Reporting** \- participating in all phases of reconciliation work to compare legacy output to BR’s solution for the same inputs using BDC (BR Data Control). Prioritizing \& driving improvements to match rates and daily reporting both internally and to clients.
* **Team Management** – day to day management of the implementation resources assigned to a project. May include direct team management or working in a matrix manner.
* **Environment Management**– definition, execution \& reporting of environment setup runbooks, and the definition of integration points, monitoring \& control frameworks and releases. Release management also includes communicating release content and timing with clients \& internal teams.
* **Production Readiness** – managing the checklist and collaborating with internal and client stakeholders to ensure projects are successfully implemented on time, robust and secure. Includes internal reporting on progress to enable good governance.

 **Qualifications:**

* 10\+ yrs experience as a conversions/implementation consultant or manager, working on SaaS project delivery to Wealth or Capital Markets organizations.
* 7 yrs experience project management experience.
* 5 yrs team leading experience, task managing teams of up to 5 resources.
* Demonstratable critical thinking and of proactively driving successful conclusions.
* Ability to define control processes, and to distil salient facts from the resulting data to report cleanly and clearly to senior management \& clients.
* Client facing, and able to build good working relationships with clients whilst being strong enough to defend BR’s position.
* Experience of large\-scale projects and solid understanding of the full project lifecycle and Governance.
* Experience of working in an agile environment with JIRA.
* Excellent attention to detail to enable accurate reporting.
* Ability to handle multiple work streams and assignments simultaneously.
* Ability to understand and challenge the detail.
* Data analysis including use of SQL \& Excel.

 **Desirable Experience:**

* Asset Servicing platforms (either in\-house or vendor solutions) in a Wealth Management, Investment Banking, or other financial environment.
* Subject matter expertise in all areas of Asset Servicing including Dividends, Coupons, Tax and Corporate Actions (Mandatory \& Elective) announcements and processing.
* A thorough understanding of the Asset Servicing lifecycle and components including:


o Event capture (multi\-source)


o Data quality / data cleansing


o Position and Transaction types


o Entitlement processing including trade generation and resulting ledgers


o Integration with US Market Participants (eg BoNY and DTCC)

* Product knowledge covering Equities and Fixed Income
* Previous experience at Broadridge or with Broadridge products such as Astrid, BPS, Impact, IPE/Gloss or ICS’ Notifications.
* Reconciliations experience, ideally with BR’s Data Control.

*Hourly range $100\-125/hr*

*Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.*

*\#LI\-MR1*

*\#LI\-REMOTE*

  

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**


As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

jobs.description:
**Why work at TidalHealth?**


Looking for a rewarding place to work? Choose TidalHealth, which now includes three hospitals – TidalHealth Peninsula Regional in Salisbury, Maryland; TidalHealth Nanticoke in Seaford, Delaware; and TidalHealth Atlantic in Berlin, Maryland. All three hospitals are “A” rated by Leapfrog Hospital Safety Guide, and the facilities have received numerous other honors.


TidalHealth is regularly adding new practices to grow our offerings in specialty and subspecialty services. These include neurosurgery, cardiothoracic surgery, joint replacement, emergency/trauma care, comprehensive cancer care, wound care, clinical trials and research, and more. TidalHealth is also home to a growing graduate medical education program to prepare the next generation of physician specialists.


Located on the beautiful Delmarva Peninsula, close to the beach, becoming part of Team TidalHealth also offers an ideal opportunity for work\-life balance. Take advantage of our tuition assistance and scholarship programs to grow both personally and professionally.


**EMR Analyst II Position Summary**


The EMR Analyst II provides analytical expertise in the development and implementation of system\-related clinical, access, revenue cycle, decision support and quality improvement applications. He / she will support new project development including system analysis, planning and preparation. Develop, support and maintain documentation and procedures as needed. Provide training to other IT staff and user clients as appropriate. Provides product function, design, and build expertise (obtains EMR module certification) and experience needed for successful product implementation. Supports all project team members with application and information systems knowledge. The Application Analyst is a member of the team of primary resources dedicated to designing, building, testing, and activating the application database. Develops and maintains models and documentation of business and system requirements and configures system accordingly. Documents and maintains all required system design and build documents. Contributes to preparation of testing scripts and materials and performs unit, system, and integrated testing tasks. Works with training team to develop application specific training curriculums and materials. Provides expertise and experience to the development of activation plans, application activation tasks, and production environment readiness. Logs, tracks, and resolves issues as well as any software code modifications or enhancements


**EMR Analyst II Position Requirements**


Required License and/or Certification


* Has EPIC certification in assigned modules


Education


* Bachelor’s degree preferred. Extensive work experience may be considered in lieu of educational requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Experience


* 3 years of relevant work experience in healthcare or similar fields.


**EMR Analyst II Work Schedule**


* Day shift, Monday through Friday with call. Overtime may be required.
* Expected to respond in the event of a disaster.


**EMR Analyst II Benefits**


* At TidalHealth, full\-time employees working at least 72 hours per pay period, part\-time employees working at least 36 hours per pay period and part\-time employees working at least 30 hours or more on weekends only are eligible for benefits.
* Benefits include medical, prescription, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, disability insurance plans, life insurance, paid time off plans, retirement plans, tuition assistance, employee assistance, and access to on\-site childcare and a credit union.

  



  

Location: TidalHealth · Information Services\-TidalHealth Peninsula Regional  

Schedule: Full Time, Monday \- Friday, 8:00\-4:30pm

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Circadia Health**



Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:


* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Implementation and Support**


* Lead on\-site implementation of Circadia's monitoring platform in SNFs, from device installation through go\-live, integrating it into existing care routines rather than adding a parallel process.
* Assess each facility before rollout: shift patterns, unit layout, staffing model, EHR workflow, and connectivity constraints.
* Build and execute the facility implementation plan with clear owners, dates, and dependencies, keeping it current as conditions change.
* Serve as first\-line support after launch: troubleshoot devices and connectivity, resolve staff questions, and escalate product issues with enough detail for Engineering to act.
* Track device uptime and utilization by facility, unit, and shift, and flag gaps before the customer does.


**Training and Adoption**


* Deliver training to clinical and frontline staff across all shifts, including nights and weekends, where adoption gaps usually live.
* Tailor content and delivery to the audience. CNAs, nurses, DONs, unit managers, and facility IT each need a different version.
* Build and maintain training materials and a knowledge base that hold up after you leave the building.
* Identify the behavioral reason adoption is lagging rather than defaulting to another session, and retrain where retraining is the actual fix.
* Develop facility champions and super\-users so competence survives staff turnover.


**Relationship Management and Collaboration**


* Build working trust with facility teams at every level, from the floor to the administrator, so staff surface issues early.
* Coordinate with in\-house care teams and remote clinical providers so the customer experiences one program, not several.
* Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, contributing implementation insight and ensuring device data is used inside patient care plans.
* Partner with Customer Success, Clinical, Support, and Engineering to unblock deployments, and own customer\-facing communication while a dependency is open.
* Hand off to Customer Success with a documented account state: utilization baseline, stakeholder map, and open risks.


**Quality Improvement and Compliance**


* Feed field evidence to Product and Engineering: failure modes, workflow friction, and what staff actually do with the product.
* Ensure all activity complies with regulatory standards and patient safety guidelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of implementation activity, staff education, and device functionality checks, aligned to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Follow facility protocols on HIPAA, infection control, and site access.

**Qualifications**
------------------



**Must\-have**


* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a healthcare setting.
* Comfort operating inside healthcare environments, particularly skilled nursing facilities, with working knowledge of nursing workflows, shift structure, and floor dynamics.
* Clear, confident verbal and written communication with the ability to train and hold a room of clinical staff.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility quickly with audiences ranging from CNAs to facility administrators.
* Practical problem\-solving: you diagnose the cause on site rather than escalating it as\-is.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing your own schedule, follow\-up, and commitments across multiple facilities at once.
* Organizational rigor with project tracking tools such as Monday.com. Nothing lives only in your head.
* Willingness to travel up to 75%, including early mornings and occasional overnight shift coverage.


**Preferred**


* Experience implementing healthcare technology, remote patient monitoring, or telehealth services in provider settings.
* Clinical background or license (RN, LPN, RT, CNA) or direct post\-acute operations experience.
* Experience training frontline staff in high\-turnover environments.


As a full\-time **Implementation Specialist,** you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 \- $100,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.



Annual salary is only one part of an employee's total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

Circadia Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
